title: ui live e2e: master-detail.spec.ts times out waiting for POST /api/v1/batch (15 s), twice on 2026-10-31 — once on main, once ejecting a queued PR
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a gate that went red twice in one day on the same helper, measured by the triage seat's health read (R798 and R801 on #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reach: every lane. `Live E2E UI` is in CI on main and in the merge queue. When it fails, main reads red, and a queued PR is ejected for a test it did not touch.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`ui/e2e/live`).

## Red (both read in the job logs)

| When | Where | Test | Failure |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 2026-10-31 17:00Z | main push `70646157` (connector-mcp OAuth, unrelated), run 41222427173 | `master-detail.spec.ts:72` "Create stores the populated parent through one atomic batch" | `TimeoutError: page.waitForResponse: Timeout 15000ms exceeded` in `submitBatch` (`:33`) |
| 2026-10-31 20:30Z | merge queue, PR #28465 (`1906a644`, objectql/rest/metadata-core datasource), run 41239207302 | `master-detail.spec.ts:96` "Create with a task line stores the child referencing the parent" | the same `submitBatch` timeout |

- In both runs it was 1 failed and 15 passed. Both later main heads after the first hit ran the job green (`16e7a808`, `776c1d87`), so this is intermittent, not a deterministic break.
- Neither PR touches the master-detail create path. The spec was last changed on 10-29 (`2cbe559d`), and `5e1342a6` (#27969) changed the create form on 10-30.
- The failure artifacts (screenshot, video, `error-context.md`, `backend.log`) are attached to both runs as `ui-live-e2e-failure-artifacts`.

## Wanted

- Root-cause the missing `POST /api/v1/batch` from the artifacts. Two things are possible: the submit click never fires the batch (a form not ready, a disabled button, a validation banner), or the backend answers after 15 s. The screenshot and `backend.log` should tell which one.
- Fix the cause. "Flake" is not a root cause. ⛔ No retry wrapper, no longer timeout without a measured reason, no skip or quarantine.
- Pin it: the spec waits on the condition that makes the submit valid, not on time.

## Dedupe

Searched the issues updated most recently for `master-detail`, `submitBatch`, `api/v1/batch` and `Live E2E`: none. **New.**
